name: A Difficult Path
summary: In Deathknell, a newly awakened Forsaken paladin begins training with the Light. After facing the undead outside the crypt, you are sent to the village church to meet Aramis Hammerhand and learn what holy power demands of the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Reeking Scroll
sections.body: After you clear feral undead from outside the crypt, Shadow Priest Sarvis gives you an unexpected delivery. The Consecrated Scroll shines with holy energy, and Sarvis recoils before asking you to step aside. For one devoted to shadow and decay, the Holy Light burns like an open flame.

sections.title: The Crucible of Holy Fire
sections.body: Aramis Hammerhand waits inside Deathknell’s desecrated church to train Forsaken paladins. Other races may wield the Light with ease and joy, but the undead endure searing agony when they call upon it. Aramis speaks plainly: channeling holy power through a rotting body is torment. He expects his disciples to face that pain instead of shrinking from it, and let it temper their resolve.

faq.q: Why does Shadow Priest Sarvis dislike the scroll?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Sarvis serves shadow magic, and the Consecrated Scroll radiates holy energy that is hostile to undead flesh. Its presence unsettles those devoted to the Shadow.

faq.q: Can Forsaken truly wield the Holy Light without dying?
faq.answer: Yes. Forsaken can wield the Light through willpower and faith, but channeling it causes intense pain, especially when healing themselves or others. It takes great mental endurance.
Aramis Hammerhand trains paladins in Deathknell. He teaches newly risen Forsaken to endure the pain of wielding the Light in undeath and make it an effective weapon.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You meet Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell’s central clearing, then go a short distance to the village’s ruined chapel, where Aramis Hammerhand lives.

faq.q: Do I have to read the Consecrated Scroll to complete the quest?
faq.answer: No. You can speak to Aramis Hammerhand inside the church without reading the Consecrated Scroll, and your training advances.

The name reflects the hardship of being a Forsaken paladin. Other warriors of the Light find comfort in their faith, while an undead paladin endures holy fire burning through dead flesh with every blessing or strike.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a first trial that makes holy power an agony to endure, demanding discipline and resolve.
As Forsaken, you can call upon the Light through devotion and discipline, though its power burns the dead flesh that channels it.
